description: Store the summary you wrote for an item you leased with driftnet_lease_items; this ends the lease and takes it off the queue. Only for leased items that have no summary yet; to redo an existing card use driftnet_refresh_item. Write in the language and depth the lease brief gives. name is the tool's own untranslated name. highlights and use_cases are short facts you read, not marketing. primary_url only if you saw it on the page. mentions are other tools the content recommends, not ones it merely compares against. category is a folder id from the brief and is ignored when the reader filed the item by hand. It makes network calls: driftnet checks that primary_url exists and looks up open-source mentions on GitHub, cataloguing them as items of their own. Fields containing prompt-injection text are rejected; on rejection it returns the reason and the item stays leased to you, so fix the fields and call again.

category.description: Best-fitting folder id from the brief's folder list, e.g. 'coding'

demo.description: What a person sees or gets when using it, 1–3 sentences; null if unknown

highlights.description: Concrete things it does, short phrases, up to 3 (5 at detailed depth); only facts you read

id.description: Item id from driftnet_lease_items, a positive integer such as 42

mentions.description: Up to 8 other tools the content recommends, not ones it only compares against

name.description: Name of another tool the content recommends, e.g. 'pandoc'

open_source.description: true if open source; such tools are looked up on GitHub and catalogued too

name.description: The tool's own name, untranslated, e.g. its GitHub repo name 'markitdown'

one_liner.description: What it is, one sentence in the brief's language, up to 300 chars

primary_url.description: http(s) URL of the tool's repo or official site, only if you saw it; verified to exist

try_it.description: Install/run command or first step, e.g. 'pip install markitdown'; null if the content does not give one

use_cases.description: Situations where someone would use it, up to 3 (2 at standard depth)

why.description: One sentence on why this reader should look, from chat text, note or the post's claim; null if no signal, never invented

worth.description: skip: not a usable tool or nothing to read; low: marginal; normal: worth a look; must-see: exceptional

name: driftnet_enrich_item
title: Store a summary for a leased item
